authoring: Single original RGBA base per effect. Runtime procedural motion; NOT a flipbook.

blade_arc.layout_operation: Uniform Lanczos fit complete source within 896x896, centered on 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Alpha preserved; no threshold, background removal or effect painting.
blade_arc.origin: top-left texture pixel origin; pivot normalized from top-left
blade_arc.direction: right-facing curved slash; mirror X for left
blade_arc.loop_note: One-shot only. No authored animation frames or seamless loop. Runtime motion is procedural demonstration.

lightning_arc.layout_operation: Uniform Lanczos fit source within 896x896, centered on 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Original generated alpha preserved; no effect painting or background removal.
limitations: One generated authored frame only, not a hand-animated flipbook.
Violet-blue halo is baked into source; isolate motion with mesh, UV flow and localized sparks.
Do not use high-frequency full-screen flashes; use small localized low-amplitude intensity changes.
Runtime distortion and elliptical UV rotation require overscan validation; texture gutter alone is not sufficient.

lightning_ring.overscan_note: 0.30 is initial render expansion for integrator QA, not proof of arbitrary full rotations. Keep ellipse-aware ring flow; full UV-plane rotation can clip or distort thin ellipse. Prefer mesh phase flow or larger padded render quad.
